in_sanskrit.name: Rhea
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Goddess of the Earth
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Rhea एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। In Hindu mythology, Rhea (also spelled as Reya or Rhea Devi) is the goddess of the earth and the wife of the god Cronus (Saturn). She is the mother of Zeus (Jupiter), Hades (Pluto), Poseidon (Neptune), Hestia (Vesta), Demeter (Ceres), and Hera (Juno). Her name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Prithvi', meaning 'earth'.
